Class NonPlayable

java.lang.Object
entities.players.Players
entities.players.NonPlayable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bat, Gumba, Marchand, MaskGuy, Octorok, Odette
public abstract class NonPlayable extends Players
Abstract class representing a non-playable character (NPC) in the game.

Extends the Players class and adds behavior specific to NPCs, such as targeting a playable character, autonomous movement, handling damage, and potential item drops.
